name: membraince
description: Long-term memory for Claude: recall what matters and remember durable facts, preferences, and decisions across conversations.
long_description: MemBraince stores your memories with the conversation each one came from, and corrections never erase history. Claude can recall relevant memories, remember new facts, and forget memories you ask it to. Requires a MemBraince API key from https://membraince.com/portal.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a fact, preference, decision, or correction.

api_key.title: MemBraince API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://membraince.com/portal (starts with mb_live_).

user_id.title: Memory owner
user_id.description: Whose memories these are inside your account. Use the same value as in Claude Code to share memories.

project.title: Project
project.description: Optional. A project name from the portal to save to and recall from. Leave empty to save to the key's home project and recall from every project linked to the key.
